summary.text: Doc Corvese is a Democratic state representative from District 55 who took office in 1999 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Arthur "Doc" Corvese, describes him as an optometrist and the House deputy majority leader.

paragraphs.text: Corvese earned a B.S. from Providence College in 1977 and an O.D. from the New England College of Optometry in 1981, and his professional experience includes working as an optometrist, according to Ballotpedia.
From 1987 to 1998 he served as a school committeeman in North Providence, Rhode Island.
